lines.text: Many learners say: I have been here yesterday.
Was! I was at home yesterday.

native.tip: Kita bilang “Kemarin saya sudah ke sini.” lalu pakai have been. Di bahasa Inggris, dengan yesterday pakai was, bukan have been.
native.caption: Pernah bilang begini? “I have been here yesterday.” 😅 Dengan yesterday, pakai was: “I was here yesterday.” Dengarkan Kak Ama, lalu ulangi! Latihan lagi di app Lexkite.
native.comment: Jawaban: “was”. Ucapkan dengan lantang: “I was here yesterday.” lalu tulis satu kalimat tentang kemarin. Latihan gratis lainnya di sini: {link}

en.tip: We say “Kemarin saya sudah ke sini.” and use have been. In English, with yesterday use was, not have been.
en.caption: Ever say this? “I have been here yesterday.” 😅 With yesterday, use was: “I was here yesterday.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
